text:
[NDBG.14.6.1] Returns the Rete network topology, optionally scoped to
one rule and optionally including live node occupancy.

Request:
```json
{ "rule_name": "alert_high", "include_occupancy": true }
```

Response:
```json
{
  "nodes": [
    { "id": "17",
      "kind": "alpha",
      "label": "Sensor",
      "filter": "value > 90.0",
      "occupancy": 2,
      "source": { "path": "rules.ds", "line": 1, "col": 1 } },
    { "id": "5",
      "kind": "terminal",
      "label": "alert_high",
      "pending_activations": 1,
      "source": { "path": "rules.ds", "line": 8, "col": 1 } }
  ],
  "edges": [
    { "from": "17", "to": "5" }
  ]
}
```
